definitions.gloss: purchase price; wholesale cost; cost price
definitions.explanation: The price at which a retailer or business buys goods from a supplier or wholesaler, before adding markup for resale. A fundamental concept in commerce and business.

examples.japanese: {仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
{仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{売|う}ったら→売る：00906_uru⟧⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you sell below the purchase price, you'll be in the red.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原材料|げんざいりょう}→原材料：18966_genzairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高騰|こうとう}→高騰：14647_koutou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}→上昇：11296_joushou⟧し、⟦{販売|はんばい}{価格|かかく}→販売価格：24607_hanbaikakaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転嫁|てんか}→転嫁：14291_tenka⟧⟦せざる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}なく→得る：02014_eru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Due to soaring raw material costs, the purchase prices rose and we had no choice but to pass the costs on to the selling price.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{仕入|しい}れ→仕入れ：07431_shiire⟧ (purchasing, stocking) and ⟦{値|ね}→値：03527_ne⟧ (price). The price a business pays to acquire goods, as opposed to the selling price ({売|う}り{値|ね}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: the purchase price rises
- {仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧: the purchase price falls
- {仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧: to sell at cost
- {仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧: to keep purchase costs down

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{原価|げんか}→原価：05470_genka⟧: cost price — the total cost including manufacturing and procurement
- ⟦{卸値|おろしね}→卸値：15949_oroshine⟧: wholesale price — price at which wholesalers sell to retailers
- ⟦{売値|うりね}→売値：07957_urine⟧: selling price — the price at which goods are sold to customers
- ⟦{定価|ていか}→定価：04066_teika⟧: list price, retail price — the manufacturer's suggested price
